verdict.rationale: dlt is an open-source Python library with a CLI, MCP server and managed hub, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions for it. The evidence pack never mentions API versioning, semantic versioning, changelogs or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path, and the pip install and CLI mentions say nothing about version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
